messages.author: 91321cd06449408d
messages.subject: Explore/Interactive
parts:
I updated Rattle to its latest version (3.4.2, on Mac OX 10.10.2/Yosemite) and I didn't see Latticist option in the Explore/Interactive tab.
GGobi is still there but it's (still) not working as well.

This will leave no Interactive option available.

Is there anything I can do to get either Latticist or GGobi work?

I'm using Rattle in a graduate Data Mining course I teach and students liked it quite a lot, so far.
Course is at its 3rd edition (it would be the 1st with no interactive data exploration ...).

Thanks and regards
Carlo

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Explore/Interactive
parts:
Hi Carlo,

Latticist was removed because the author of that package has stopped updating it and it has been removed from CRAN and CRAN does not allow other packages to refer to removed packages!

If you have Latticist installed anyhow, you could call it from the R Console command line and pass it the crs$dataset argument to interact with the dataset that Rattle currently has loaded.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
